::: {#cor-prior-support}
#### The posterior cannot put probability where the prior puts none

If $\p(\theta) = 0$ for every $\theta$ in a set $A \subset \Theta$,
then $\p(\theta \mid \vy) = 0$ for every $\theta \in A$,
whatever the data $\vy$.
:::

::: proof
For $\theta \in A$,
the numerator of @eq-bayes-posterior is
$\p(\vy \mid \theta) \cdot 0 = 0$.
:::
